It is incredibly difficult to provide strength to someone else when you feel like you are running on empty yourself. When you are facing a pay cut, the threat of layoffs, and the lingering stress of a family health scare, your own emotional reserves are naturally depleted.

It is okay to acknowledge that you are struggling. Supporting someone doesn't always have to mean having all the answers or being "strong" in the traditional sense; sometimes, it is simply about being present in the shared experience. 

How are you managing to balance your own needs with the desire to be there for her right now?
